Pneumatic Components

Parts for push-in pneumatic fittings and tubing. Select a generator to enter parameters and preview/download the model.

Orifice

Pneumatic tube connector with an orifice between two sockets; optionally a joined series of orifice sizes.

Blind Plug

Solid pin that closes a port of a push-in fitting; presets for 4 and 6 mm tube.
